full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white film photograph frames a man and a woman facing one another at close range in a dim interior. The man occupies the left half in three-quarter profile. He has short dark hair swept back, a clean-shaven face, and a light gray textured jacket over a white shirt and narrow dark tie. His brow lifts slightly as he looks toward the woman, and a faint smile sits at one corner of the mouth. The woman fills the right half in left-facing profile, her eyes meeting his. She has dark hair gathered into a high rounded style with soft fringe over her forehead, a small earring, and a dark top with a simple neckline. Her expression is warm but reserved, with a slight smile. Their faces sit at nearly the same height, close enough that the narrow gap between them becomes the focus. Behind them, dark vertical interior surfaces and a distant soft blur suggest a public room, but no specific furnishings are clear. A bright light from high at the left catches the man’s forehead and cheek and softly outlines the woman’s nose and jaw; the background remains deep black. The grain is fine but visible, and the face tones fall through many shades of gray rather than hard graphic black and white. The man’s light jacket forms a broad middle-gray mass against the woman’s dark garment. The framing cuts both figures below the chest and crops the outer edges closely. No readable text appears. The overall composition uses the paired profiles and a luminous narrow space between them to make an intimate, quietly cinematic moment.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白胶片照片在昏暗室内近距离框住面对面的男子与女子。男子占据左半，以四分之三侧面入画。他留向后梳的短深发，面庞刮净胡须，穿浅灰有纹理外套、白衬衫和窄深色领带。看向女子时眉毛略抬，嘴角有微笑。女子以朝左侧面填满右半，目光与他相接。她将深发盘成高而圆的发式，额前有柔软刘海，戴小耳饰，穿领口简洁的深色上衣。神情温暖却克制，带浅笑。两张脸几乎处于同一高度，距离很近，之间狭窄空隙成为焦点。身后深色竖向室内表面与远处柔焦暗示公共房间，但看不清具体家具。左上高处亮光照亮男子额头和面颊，并柔和勾出女子鼻子与下颌；背景保持深黑。胶片颗粒细而可见，脸部色调跨越许多灰阶，而非硬性的纯黑白图形。男子浅色外套形成宽阔中灰体量，与女子深色衣物相对。画幅在两人胸部以下裁断，也紧紧裁切外边缘。没有可读文字。整体构图以成对侧面和两人之间明亮狭缝，形成亲密而安静的电影感瞬间。
style_prompt_en: A black-and-white film-photographic image uses fine grain, velvety dark areas, and a wide range of soft grays. Two closely spaced tonal masses turn toward a narrow light interval, creating a focused intimate balance. High-side illumination models selected surfaces gently and leaves the surrounding environment underexposed. Edges are crisp around the lit focal area but fall away into soft blur and deep shadow at the margins. Midgray texture provides a bridge between pale highlights and black fields. Tight cropping and shallow focus keep depth modest and attention concentrated. The finish is natural, quietly cinematic, and emotionally restrained.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白胶片摄影图像使用细颗粒、丝绒般深色区域和宽广柔灰阶。两块相距很近的明暗体量转向狭窄亮区，形成集中的亲密平衡。高处侧光柔和塑出部分表面，让周围环境曝光不足。受光焦点周围边缘清晰，画幅边缘则落入柔焦与深影。中灰纹理连接浅亮部与黑色域。紧密裁切和浅景深令纵深适度、注意力集中。成品自然、安静地富电影感，情绪克制。
theme_en: A man and woman exchanging a close look in a monochrome photograph
theme_zh: 黑白照片中近距离对视的男女
name: Francois Truffaut
